Certified at all 1210 minima: (1) Du Dd is physical to 4.0e-16; the WP21e reduced form L = M W/(gap D_other) holds pointwise (residuals 1.9e-9 on W=+-1 classes; a v1 formula error re-inserting ln chi_b(s) was caught by the residual audit - the chi cancels against Du_sec, worth knowing if you use the 1947 form). (2) The level problem is now exactly: why five values of K = M W/gap. The two rigid clusters realize K by near-unique magnitude assignments: cluster 1 is L = M/Dd EXACTLY (residual 4e-14, corr(lnM,lnL)=1.0); cluster 2 is all-W=+-1 with corr 0.964. So your zero-trench mechanism has two regimes to explain: point-like magnitude islands (rigid) and exact compensation surfaces (conspiracy). Certificate: results/wp26_level_anatomy.json.
